en.title: Concat: Free and Open-Source CapCut Alternative (Formerly WolfCut)
en.hook: Looking for a privacy-focused, free and open-source video editor to replace CapCut? This is it.
key_takeaways: Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) designed as a direct replacement for CapCut
Formerly known under the project name WolfCut
Offers local-first video editing capabilities with no subscription walls
